note: Mix design v2. W=175 kg/m3 (assumed workability). B=W/(w/b), C=(1-f)B, FA=fB, w/c=W/C. Decision vars w/b in [0.35,0.65], f in [0,0.40]. B in [280,500]. w_eq=W/(C+0.4*min(FA,0.33C)) (EN 206 k-value concept). ASSUMED limits, to be verified against EN 206: w_eq<=0.55 (main, "XC3/XC4-type limit, assumed"), 0.50, 0.60; C>=260 kg/m3 (assumed). Strength not modelled/constrained. f1 = conformal UPPER bound (alpha 0.10) of 28-d depth, condition A (CO2 20 %, 20 C, 70 % RH). f2 = embodied CO2 kg/m3 = C*EF_c+FA*EF_fa+W*EF_w (A1-A3, binder+water; aggregates/admixtures excluded => PARTIAL). NSGA-II pop 100, 200 gen, 3 seeds, merged non-dominated front. Data-support constraint (range + 5-NN <= p95 = 2.262) also applied.
